newsitem.title: UK: Granada luxury hotels sale attracts interest.
newsitem.headline: Granada luxury hotels sale attracts interest.

text.p: A number of groups are interested in buying all 17 luxury hotels which leisure company Granada Group Plc has put on the market, sources close to the negotiations said on Wednesday.

The hotels, known as the Exclusive range, were among properties acquired by Granada after its 3.9 billion stg takeover of Forte in January. Granada is hoping to raise in excess of one billion stg from the sale.
Interested parties are expected to complete due diligence by the end of the month before tabling final offers.

A Granada spokesman declined comment on a report in London's Evening Standard on Wednesday that the Sultan of Brunei was set to buy the Hyde Park Hotel for 90 million stg, 25 million above book value.
The Hyde Park is one of four London hotels in the Exclusive portfolio. It also includes properties in New York, Paris, Madrid and Rome.
The Standard report listed U.S. hotel companies ITT Sheraton and Marriott as potential purchasers of the whole chain.
